company.description: The founder's own company. url decides which extracted pages count as the company's site.

founder_notes.description: The founder's own words, typed or pasted: who they sell to, and often the interview so far as 'Q: ...' / 'A: ...' lines, which count as earlier answers.

founder_docs.description: The founder's existing material as text (positioning, pitch, an old ICP draft, call notes), often an uploaded file. Read before any question; 'Q: ...' / 'A: ...' line pairs count as earlier interview answers.

answers.description: The interview so far, in order. field is the next_question.field the question was asked for.

answer.description: The founder's reply, as typed. skip, don't know or empty leaves the field unresolved.

won_examples.description: Companies the founder won, typed in chat (no CRM).

lost_examples.description: Companies the founder lost or that never bought, typed in chat (no CRM).

current_icp.description: The current ICP document in this skill's markdown format, when updating an existing one.

max_questions.description: The most questions in one interview, follow-ups included.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for the changelog date. Optional: without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.

note.description: The founder's short reason, e.g. signed two weeks after an outage.
